rv.q: Catch of the Day barely qualifies as an anecdote... nobody, least of all the playwright/director Megan Jenkins, seems to have wondered why the story is worth telling.

cn.t: Red Fox Theatre's Irish pub tale charms with its droll storytelling and gleeful performances, spinning the true story of a 1966 sturgeon catch into a delightfully shaggy fish tale that honors the tradition of Irish yarn-spinning.
